_comment: SAPM Launch Governance Plan — Go/No-Go criteria, launch-day comms, freeze window, hypercare schedule, and deferred risk tracking.
_status: Approved for Alpha mainnet planning; final sign-off required at Go/No-Go meeting

gatingCriteria: Production readiness checklist >= 90% complete with no open Critical/High items
All top-5 launch risks (LR-001 through LR-005) have documented mitigations and owners
npm run release:check passes on release candidate commit
Secrets scan CI gate passes with zero findings
Dependency audit CI gate passes at --audit-level=high
DR drill executed in staging with RTO < 4 hours
Security Lead sign-off on threat model and audit report
Formal verification obligations in formal_verification/OBLIGATIONS.md reviewed and risk-accepted or closed
goNoGoProcess.decisionAuthority: Unanimous approval from Engineering Lead, Security Lead, and Ops Lead required for Go decision

launchDayCommunicationsPlan.externalStatusPage: TBD — operator-provisioned status page URL to be linked before launch

stakeholderNotification.timing: T-24h announcement, T-0 go-live confirmation, any SEV-2+ incident updates

launchDayCommunicationsPlan.onCallContact: pagerduty/sapm-oncall — active from T-1h through T+48h

codeFreeze.policy: No new feature merges to main after code freeze. Only critical security patches or explicit Go/No-Go blockers permitted. Any exception requires Engineering Lead + Security Lead approval.

releaseFreeze.policy: No changes to production infrastructure without Incident Commander approval. Rollback is the default response to any SEV-1 or SEV-2 incident during freeze.

freezeWindowPolicy.contingencyPlan: If Go/No-Go results in No-Go, the release is rescheduled by minimum 2 weeks. Engineering Leadership documents blocking items and assigns owners before new target date is set.

hypercareSchedule.onCallCoverage: 24/7 pager coverage by SRE + Orchestrator Team leads rotating on 8-hour shifts

kpiReviewCadence.anomalyThresholds: Any metric crossing its alert threshold triggers immediate review per config/alert-thresholds.json

hypercareSchedule.exitCriteria: Hypercare ends when: (1) all SLOs have maintained target for 7 consecutive days, (2) no open SEV-1 or SEV-2 incidents, (3) all PIR action items from launch window are closed or deferred with owner + date

deferredRiskRegister.policy: Any risk identified during or after launch that cannot be immediately remediated must be entered in this register with owner, due date, and mitigation plan. Reviewed daily during hypercare and weekly thereafter.

items.risk: Full TPM attestation evidence requires production hardware provisioning
items.mitigation: Software attestation path is functional and tested; hardware TPM path is an enhancement for post-Alpha hardening

items.risk: Production HSM/KMS key custody not yet provisioned for Alpha
items.mitigation: Ephemeral in-memory keys used for Alpha; KMS provisioning is gated on infrastructure approval and scheduled before Beta
